bug.title: Shield’s look-alike check compares the wrong last 4 characters
bug.effect: An address that copies the first and last 4 characters of a saved contact is no longer blocked.

caughtBy: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
fixDiff:
-    const twin = contacts.find((c) => c.address.slice(0, 4) === a.slice(0, 4) && c.address.slice(-4) === a.slice(-5, -1));
+    const twin = contacts.find((c) => c.address.slice(0, 4) === a.slice(0, 4) && c.address.slice(-4) === a.slice(-4));
